newsitem.title: USA: Insilco seeks buyers for Rolodex unit.
newsitem.headline: Insilco seeks buyers for Rolodex unit.

text.p: Insilco Corp said Monday it has hired Goldman, Sachs & Co to help review its options, including identifying possible buyers of its Rolodex business unit.
The news comes just days after Insilco announced the sale of its Rolodex electronic organizer product line. In September, the company sold its Curtis personal computer accessory business.
Insilco said it expects the sale of the Rolodex electronic organizer line to produce a fourth-quarter gain. Terms of that sale were not disclosed.
In last year's fourth quarter, the company reported net income of $700,000, or $0.07 per share, on revenues of $135 million.
